practical: Operation on DC, 1Ø Induction, 3Ø Induction, and Universal motors on AEMT; Cleaning of connectors and terminals.
intro_questions: What are the three types of motors covered in this practical?
List two essential safety precautions before starting any motor operation.
Why is cleaning connectors and terminals critical for motor performance?

development.content:
Safety Precautions for AEMT Operation
Cleaning Connectors and Terminals
DC Motor Operation Procedure
Universal Motor Operation Procedure

Single Phase Induction Motor Operation
Three Phase Induction Motor Operation
Troubleshooting Common Motor Faults
Verification of Motor Rotation Direction

Final Inspection of Motors
Documentation of Practical Results
Review of Safety Compliance
Q&A Session on Motor Operations

summary_questions: Describe the correct sequence for cleaning motor terminals before operation.
Explain the difference in starting procedures between a DC motor and a 3Ø Induction motor.
Identify three signs that indicate a motor is overheating during operation.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report detailing the specific safety checks performed on the AEMT motors and how they relate to the safety protocols discussed in LP 02.
